title: How bricks are made
steps: Clay is dug from the ground by a digger
Clay is passed through a sieve onto a roller
Sand and water are added and mixed
The mixture is pressed into moulds
Bricks are dried in an oven for 24 to 48 hours
Bricks are heated in a kiln at high temperature
Bricks are cooled for 48 to 72 hours
Bricks are packaged and delivered

title: The life cycle of a frog
steps: Adult frog lays eggs (frogspawn) in water
Eggs hatch into tadpoles after about 10 days
Tadpoles feed on plants and breathe through gills
Back legs appear at about 6 weeks
Front legs grow and the tail shrinks
Young froglet leaves the water
Froglet grows into an adult frog in about 3 years

title: Producing electricity from rubbish
steps: Rubbish is collected and delivered to the plant
Recyclable metals are removed
Rubbish is burned in a furnace
Heat boils water in a boiler to make steam
Steam drives a turbine connected to a generator
Electricity is sent to the national grid
Ash is collected and used in road building

title: How rainwater is collected for a house
steps: Rain falls on the roof
Water runs into gutters and down a pipe
Leaves and dirt are caught by a filter
Water is stored in an underground tank
A pump sends water to the house
Water is used for toilets and the garden
Excess water overflows into a soakaway

title: How instant coffee is produced
steps: Coffee cherries are picked
Beans are removed and dried
Beans are roasted and then ground
Ground coffee is mixed with hot water
The liquid is filtered
The liquid is frozen at minus 40 degrees
Frozen coffee is broken into granules
Water is removed in a vacuum to dry the granules
Granules are packed into jars

title: The water cycle
steps: The sun heats water in oceans and lakes
Water evaporates and rises as vapour
Vapour cools and condenses into clouds
Water falls as rain or snow
Water runs off into rivers or soaks into the ground
Rivers and groundwater carry water back to the sea
